scope: Geographic overview and exploratory labels; not project visits, address geocoding, street maps, navigation, or survey-grade boundaries.

world.processing: Original geometry preserved. Cartographic generalization at 1:110m; not suitable for local precision.

chinaProvinces.notes: 34 province-level features plus special 100000_JD feature. Source administrative vintage not independently confirmed.

chinaPrefectures.notes: All 34 province-level endpoints attempted with at most 4 concurrent requests; Taiwan endpoint unavailable. Municipalities, Hong Kong, and Macao provide district-level children; other regions primarily prefecture-level children. Province name/adcode properties added, original geometries preserved in originalFile.

dataVCoordinateProcessing.sourceConvention: DataV official documentation describes GCJ-02 as its primary map coordinate system. The downloaded GeoJSON does not embed an independently authoritative CRS declaration.
dataVCoordinateProcessing.displayConversion: DataV source coordinates interpreted as GCJ-02; separate WGS84-named files apply six iterative inverse-offset steps and round to six decimals. Original files are retained unchanged (except collection provenance / province fields on the merged file).
dataVCoordinateProcessing.precision: Approximate alignment for geographic visualization only; neither transformation nor source boundaries are survey-grade. Coordinate conversion residual is not evidence of source positional accuracy.

cities.notes: First 65 entries are curated Chinese display labels. 64 use Natural Earth geographic city points; Macao uses an explicitly marked approximate overview center. Chinese descriptions and province labels are editorial geographic summaries. The following 312 centers use DataV city-level centers with the documented approximate inverse GCJ-02 transformation. Each new center preserves sourceCoordinates. Coordinates denote overview city/administrative centers, not precise project addresses. No location is claimed as visited.

chinaDistricts.notes: District detail is intentionally limited to the selected cities. District labels additionally include Beijing, Tianjin, Shanghai, and Chongqing from the existing province-children collection. Boundaries and centers use the same documented approximate inverse GCJ-02 conversion. This is administrative detail, not streets or building geometry; source administrative vintage not independently confirmed.
